title: Batch correction in single-cell data
abstract: A framework for batch correction in scRNA-seq.

methods.name: methods
methods.text: We applied Harmony v0.1.0 to correct batch effects using donor identity as the grouping variable, with theta=2 and lambda=1. Highly variable genes were selected using the top 2000 genes by variance. Principal component analysis was performed on log-normalized counts using the first 30 components. UMAP was computed with n_neighbors=30 and min_dist=0.3. Cluster identity was determined via Louvain clustering at resolution=0.8.
